source.title: Call for Applicants - WEAT Leader (July 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,


There will be an appointment of a new WCA Executive Assistants Team (WEAT) Leader. The WCA Board is currently overseeing WEAT, and recent team growth has created a need to formally appoint a leader.


Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

- Solid knowledge of the structure and workflow inside the WCA
- Proficiency in English
- Good communication skills and proficiency in English
- A reasonable daily availability to deploy the duties
- Team and project management capabilities


The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until July 28th, 2025, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).


The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

- Brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions as the WEAT Leader of the WCA.


Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.


The rights and duties of the WEAT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.25.5](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.5%20-%20Executive%20Assistants%20Team.pdf).


After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf). 


Thanks for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 董事会助理团队负责人招募（2025 年 7 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 将任命新的董事会助理团队（WEAT）负责人。目前 WEAT 由 WCA 董事会直接管理，随着近期团队规模扩大，需要正式任命一位负责人。

候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 8 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

- 熟悉 WCA 内部的组织架构和工作流程。
- 熟练使用英语。
- 良好的沟通能力和熟练的英语能力。
- 每天能安排适当时间履行职责。
- 团队及项目管理能力。

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 2025 年 7 月 28 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 担任 WCA 董事会助理团队负责人后的工作设想。

申请者还须提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WEAT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.25.5](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.5%20-%20Executive%20Assistants%20Team.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 动议 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，通过投票选定并公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
